reason: As someone who remembers the refunds and has already given this month, B earns more trust: it opens with the failed campaign, tells me upfront that the roof cost could rise 15%, gives a Thanksgiving reopening date, admits the limit on new releases, and is signed by a named chair. A makes the same core case but leaves out the roof risk and the reopening date and adds a year (2027) that was not in the facts, so it reads as a smoother pitch that is less candid.
